method: Actual original and patched MapLibre 5.6.2 constructors and WorkerScope request code in VM, native Node Request/Response/fetch and genuine structuredClone at actor boundaries. getStyle prototype exercised; source reconstruction from style exercised. This does not exercise actual Map.setStyle diff/render/CSP/Chrome URL limits or browser memory/performance.

checks.name: Canonical data URL uses native fetch/JSON in the actual WorkerScope on both original and candidate bundles
Only the dedicated source and exact canonical MIME prefix change the LD return; all other source/URL types retain full data
Synchronous serialize/getStyle remain self-contained and a new actual source reconstructed from a JSON-cloned style reloads identical data
Filter, rewind, getBounds and round-trip source serialization retain actual MapLibre behavior
Actual updateData after a compact URL response still updates GD and serializes the new full object
Actual queued setData publishes the final URL and GD data after a previous URL finishes
Data fetch failure and malformed JSON retain source errors without publishing successful source content events
Superseded worker loads abort the first native request and publish only the replacement data
Full 2,980-record input preserves GD, source style, and byte-identical actual geojson-vt/PBF tiles without returning full geometry in LD
